publication_scope: Aggregate experimental metrics only. No non-synthetic audit matter text, row identifiers, individual company observations, or trained neural model weights.

methods.baseline: TF-IDF (word 1-2 grams; max 50000 features; sublinear TF) + class-weighted LinearSVC
methods.deduplication: Normalized TITLE + DESCRIPTION exact duplicates removed, and all conflicting-label exact-text clusters excluded
methods.rare_label_rule: Native source labels with <100 examples in training mapped to OTHER_RARE
methods.status: Internal preliminary research benchmark, not publication-quality external validation

caveats: Original report years are not verified
Near-verbatim semantic cross-split leakage still requires testing
Headquarters is NOT evidence of a UK ISA (UK) auditor reporting regime
Original report years not independently verified
Near-duplicate semantic cross-split leakage requires testing

cross_country_comparison_limitation: US and UK native topic taxonomies/class supports differ; do not rank country model quality from F1.
redistribution_warning: Public-source disclosure availability is not proof that original Audit Analytics-format extracts and their assigned labels can be redistributed. This package contains no source rows.
